Displays full-screen mindful-breathing reminders and blocks ordinary touches until the countdown finishes. Reminders start automatically, including after reboot. Detects active map apps from app/window package names so they count as idle and remain unobstructed. Screen-content access is disabled. Does not read screen text, routes or locations, or store or transmit app history. Time off, locked or in maps restores the interval. A started reminder continues while off or in maps, but pauses on the lit lock screen. System controls may remain available.
